detail.title: KM730 Pro Wireless TKL Keyboard & Mouse Combo - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports KM730 Pro is a compact 75% wireless keyboard and mouse combo built to free up desk space without sacrificing essential keys. The 87-key tenkeyless keyboard runs on a 1000mAh rechargeable battery with auto-sleep, cutting down on frequent recharging, while multi-zone RGB lighting and floating keycaps deliver a vivid, immersive glow across static, breathing and light-off modes with adjustable brightness. The included wireless mouse uses a 300mAh rechargeable battery good for weeks of use per charge, with adjustable DPI and LED lighting of its own. A single 2.4GHz USB nano receiver connects both devices, and the combo works broadly across Windows, Linux, Surface, Fire OS, Android, macOS, PS4, PS5 and Xbox One X.
